'''Jean Morisson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 Smyrna tournament]] on 24 February 2001 with [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind What You Have Learned]], according to John Digiovanni's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1778">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-24-smyrna-ga-2-24-2001d1778/ smyrna-ga-2-24-2001], DeckTech (John "Parn12" Digiovanni, 24 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-24-smyrna-ga-2-24-2001d1778/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
